concept.title: Right fork operation lever
concept.shortdesc: The right side fork can be moved right or left by pulling backwards or pushing

conbody.p: The right side fork can be moved right or left by pulling backwards or pushing forwards on this lever. The moving speed can be controlled by tilt angle of the lever and accelerator pedal effort.
conbody.note: If both C and D levers are pushed forwards, forks widen, and if pulled backward, they come closer to each other.
